template.title: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
template.governing_standard: GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics
template.typical_review_timeline: 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval)

fields.label: Company / SPV Name, Sector & Geography
fields.description: Applicant entity name, climate vertical, and operating market.

fields.label: Target Capital Raise, Ticket Size & Preferred Capital Layer
fields.description: Maps stage and requested amount to equity, catalytic first-loss, project-prep, or infrastructure equity.

fields.label: Alignment with Investor Climate Thesis & COP31 Platform
fields.description: Aligns venture/project with investor's COP31 mandate (e.g., GFANZ Catalytic Capital, Allied Climate Partners early dev, Just Climate industrial/nature, BlackRock Transition Infra).

fields.label: Avoided Emissions Potential (tCO2e/yr) & Commercial Unit Economics
fields.description: Links climate impact (tCO2e per dollar deployed) with expected IRR and revenue scalability.

fields.label: Technology Differentiation, Innovation & Market Readiness
fields.description: Highlights proprietary technology, TRL maturity, and competitive advantage.

fields.label: Blended Capital Stack & Co-Investor Mobilization
fields.description: Shows existing equity/co-financing commitments and how catalytic capital unlocks scale.

fields.label: ESG Governance, Social Co-Benefits & Exclusion Compliance
fields.description: Screens fossil-fuel exclusions, permitting status, and social/gender co-benefits.

fields.label: Key Scale-Up Risks & Mitigation Strategy
fields.description: Commercial, technology, and emerging-market execution risks with mitigants.

fields.label: Investment Committee 1-Paragraph Executive Pitch
fields.description: Investor-ready pitch paragraph synthesizing commercial upside and climate impact.
